name: web-illustrated-farm-landing-hero-on-monitor-with-phone
title: Illustrated Farm Landing on Monitor with Phone
whatItIs: A cover with a flat illustrated landscape of hills, clouds, wind turbines and a drone continuing seamlessly from a monitor showing a blue farming landing page with a centred headline, and a phone in front showing a matching app home.
whatItMeans: The illustration spilling out of the screen makes the product world feel real and cheerful, and the sky blue is friendly for agtech.
